hero.badgeLong: 8 strategies · 3 levels · From retail to institutional level
hero.subtitle: A structured path, from foundations to institutional techniques, to build a solid and repeatable approach.

debutant.label: Beginner
debutant.description: The essential concepts to read the market and build solid setups.

intermediaire.label: Intermediate
intermediaire.description: The institutional concepts to understand how the market really moves.

avance.label: Advanced
avance.description: The techniques of professional traders, surgical precision and institutional reading.

price-action.title: Price Action
price-action.subtitle: Read the raw market without indicators, candles, pin bars, engulfing and multi-timeframe setups.

lecon1.title: Reading a candle: body, wick, signal
lecon1.description: The basic unit of trading. Understand the anatomy of a Japanese candlestick and what it reveals about the buyers vs sellers battle.

lecon2.title: Pin bar: the level rejection
lecon2.description: The first real trade setup. Identify a valid pin bar at a key level, trade it with precise entry, SL and TP.

lecon3.title: Engulfing: the shift in strength
lecon3.description: The 2-candle power-shift pattern. The 2nd engulfs the 1st and confirms a clear change of direction.

lecon4.title: Multi-timeframe setup Daily → H1
lecon4.description: The synthesis lesson of Module 1. Combine Daily trend, H4 level and H1 signal to build complete, coherent setups.

support-resistance.title: Support / Resistance & Range
support-resistance.subtitle: Identify the price zones that matter and trade ranging markets, polarity, range, breakout vs fakeout.

lecon1.title: Support and resistance: the zones where the market reacts
lecon1.description: Understand what support and resistance are, the zones where price regularly bounces or rejects.

lecon2.title: Identifying a real level (vs a randomly drawn line)
lecon2.description: The criteria to tell a real level from a random line, multiple touches, visible rejections, recent level.

lecon3.title: Support↔resistance flip and trading a bounce
lecon3.description: Levels don't disappear when they break, they often switch roles. Trade the retests after a flip for classic setups.

lecon4.title: Real breakout vs fake breakout
lecon4.description: Telling real breakouts from traps. Fakes are violent and reject quickly, a setup in their own right.

trend-following.title: Trend Following
trend-following.subtitle: Trade with the market using disciplined pullbacks, trend, retracement, exit on structure.

lecon1.title: Recognizing a trend (HH/HL vs LH/LL)
lecon1.description: The market only does three things: go up, go down, or wait. The visual criteria to tell the three apart.

lecon2.title: Trendline and moving averages: drawing the trend
lecon2.description: The HH/HL structure stays the base. Trendlines and MAs give a faster, cleaner read of the market.

lecon3.title: Trading with the trend: pullback and entry
lecon3.description: A trend doesn't rise in a straight line. It progresses in waves. This lesson shows you how to use these waves to enter with the market at the best price.

lecon4.title: When to exit: trend reversal
lecon4.description: BOS and CHoCH give you two objective signals to close a position before the trend reverses.

smc.title: SMC: Thinking institutional
smc.subtitle: Understand how institutions structure their positions and align with them. Supply/Demand, BOS, CHoCH, confluences.

lecon1.title: SMC Market Structure: reading market structure like an institution
lecon1.description: Identifying significant swings, telling internal from external structure, reading the accumulation, expansion, distribution phases.

lecon2.title: BOS and CHoCH: reading institutional structural signals
lecon2.description: Telling BOS from CHoCH, operationally qualifying the break, understanding the 3-step institutional reversal sequence.

lecon3.title: Order Blocks: identifying institutional zones
lecon3.description: 4-step identification process, qualification criteria, a quantified execution plan and the traps to avoid on Order Blocks.

lecon4.title: FVG and liquidity: trading the institutional imbalance
lecon4.description: Liquidity, sweep and Fair Value Gap: the complete institutional mechanics.

lecon5.title: The complete SMC trade: from HTF analysis to execution
lecon5.description: The module synthesis: assembling structure, liquidity, sweep, CHoCH and mitigation into a complete trade.

reversal.title: Reversal & Turnarounds
reversal.subtitle: Identify and trade reversals at the extremes. Fibonacci 0.618/0.786, divergences, combined confirmations.

lecon1.title: Double top / Double bottom: the reversal signature
lecon1.description: Recognizing the 2 simplest reversal patterns and trading them with a clean 2:1 R/R.

lecon2.title: Head & Shoulders: the major reversal
lecon2.description: The most famous reversal pattern. How to spot it, validate it and trade it with a round 1.5:1 R/R.

lecon3.title: RSI divergence: when momentum betrays the trend
lecon3.description: The RSI reveals the invisible momentum behind price. How to read and trade classic divergences with a 2:1 R/R.

lecon4.title: Trading a reversal: invalidation checklist
lecon4.description: The practical checklist to identify an invalidation and cut before giving back your account. Module synthesis.

multi-timeframe.title: Multi-timeframe Process
multi-timeframe.subtitle: A disciplined top-down method to turn a macro read into precise execution. Daily → H4 → H1 → entry.

lecon1.title: Why analyze in multi-timeframe
lecon1.description: Why trading a single chart makes you blind, and the role of each level: bias, zone, trigger.

lecon2.title: The higher timeframe: defining context and bias
lecon2.description: Reading the higher timeframe (H4/Daily): structure, zones, and drawing a clear directional bias from it.

lecon3.title: The intermediate timeframe: spotting the zone that matters
lecon3.description: Going down a level: locating the precise zone where the HTF scenario can trigger.

lecon4.title: The execution timeframe: the precise entry
lecon4.description: The execution timeframe (M5/M15): waiting for the trigger in the zone and entering with precision.

lecon5.title: The complete process: from Daily to M5 in one trade
lecon5.description: Running the full sequence, from Daily to M5, on a real trade from A to Z.

ict.title: Complete ICT
ict.subtitle: The pro institutional arsenal. Order Block, FVG, Liquidity sweeps, Killzones, OTE, Power of 3.

lecon1.title: Understanding the ICT model: liquidity and manipulation
lecon1.description: Why the market goes hunting for liquidity before moving, and how to read the sweep + reintegration.

lecon2.title: PD Arrays: spotting the zones where the market can react
lecon2.description: FVG, Order Blocks and confluence: identifying the premium/discount zones where a reaction is likely.

lecon3.title: Killzones: when the market really moves
lecon3.description: The time windows that concentrate volatility. Asia, London Open, New York Open.

lecon4.title: Displacement: recognizing real institutional movement
lecon4.description: Telling a real take-control impulse from a simple volatile candle with no follow-through.

lecon5.title: The complete ICT model: from liquidity to execution
lecon5.description: Running the full sequence: liquidity → manipulation → displacement → execution.

macro-trading.title: Macro Trading
macro-trading.subtitle: Trade major news and market regimes. FOMC Fade, NFP Overreaction, Risk-off regime, pre-trade macro filter.

lecon1.title: FOMC Fade: trading the swing-back after the decision
lecon1.description: Exploiting the overreaction that follows the FOMC decision, entering after it stabilizes, not in the impulse.

lecon2.title: NFP Overreaction: trading the overreaction to the US jobs report
lecon2.description: Exploiting the overreaction to the NFP headline number, entering after the repricing, not in the initial move.

lecon3.title: Risk-off regime: trading when the market flees risk
lecon3.description: Identifying a risk-off regime setting in through concordant signals and trading in its direction.

lecon4.title: The pre-trade macro filter: validating context before executing
lecon4.description: Building a systematic macro filter (calendar + regime + setup) to avoid bad trades.
